seo.title: Free Online Screen Click Counter | Tap to Tool
seo.description: Count your screen clicks easily with our free online click counter. Supports keyboard shortcuts (Space, Enter, Backspace) and a responsive design.
seo.keywords: click counter, count clicks, screen counter, online click counter, tap counter, manual counter online, tally counter

schema.app_description: Online tool to count clicks on screen or via keyboard. Simple, accurate, and free.
schema.howto_name: How to Use the Click Counter
schema.howto_description: Learn how to count your clicks using your mouse, touchscreen, or keyboard shortcuts.

ui.intro_text: A simple and efficient tool to count clicks in real time in your browser. Ideal for quick counts, click testing, and repetition tracking.

content.feature_keyboard: Keyboard Shortcuts:Use Space or Enter to add and Backspace to subtract.
content.feature_modes: Cross-Platform:Works seamlessly on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
content.feature_realtime: Instant Counting:Immediate counter updates without any delay.
content.feature_responsive: Clean Interface:Minimalist and distraction-free design focused on usability.
content.usage_step1: Click the plus (+) button on the screen or press Space/Enter on your keyboard to add a click.
content.usage_step2: Use the minus (-) button on the screen or the Backspace key to subtract a click from the count.
content.usage_step3: Press the reset button to set the count back to zero at any time.
content.usage_step4: Track the total number displayed in the center of the panel in real time.
content.shortcut_space_enter: Space / Enter: Adds +1 to the counter
content.shortcut_reset: Reset Button: Clears the accumulated number
content.footer_text: Liked this tool? Share it with your friends!
